title: Unmatched backend routes return HTTP 200 in frontend mode
reasoning: In the frontend-build branch, the catch-all route handles unmatched /api, /docs, /redoc, and /openapi.json paths after the real backend routes have failed to match. Returning a plain dict makes FastAPI send status 200, so missing backend endpoints look successful to clients, probes, and caches.
reproduction: With frontend routes enabled, GET /api/does-not-exist reaches serve_spa and returns {"detail":"Not found"} with FastAPI's default 200 status instead of 404.
recommendation: Raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Not found') or return a JSONResponse with status_code=404 for backend-reserved paths.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing tests exercise known /api/health routes and the no-frontend root response; they do not enable the frontend-build catch-all or request an unknown backend path.
suggestedRegressionTest: When a built frontend index is present, assert GET '/api/not-real' and GET '/docs/not-real' return 404, while a client-side frontend route still returns index.html with 200.
minimumFixScope: The backend-path guard inside serve_spa in app/main.py.
